title: On-screen text legibility audit for a phone
what_it_does: Records every fillText the page draws, joins them into time spans, and fails text held 0.6 s or longer that is too small at phone width (about 6.7 px on a 360 px phone), warns under 8.7 px.
when_to_use: Checking captions and cards for phone readability.
why: It hooks canvas fillText, which HyperFrames HTML does not use; keep the thresholds and the idea (HyperFrames' own check already measures contrast).
